semantics.clock: Update state on rising clk edge (conventional interpretation of synchronous FSM).
semantics.reset: Original explicitly specifies active-high synchronous reset to B; reset overrides input on the active edge.
semantics.output: Decode current state with no additional register or cycle latency.
semantics.initialization: Original gives no power-up state; no initialization is added; verification establishes a known state with synchronous reset.

numeric.port_widths: All ports one bit as explicitly specified.

verification.oracle: Original four transition arrows and state output labels, modeled independently by named state in testbench.
verification.sampling: Drive at falling edges; verify unchanged output before rising edge and expected output after NBA settling.
verification.directed: Both transitions from each state, hold versus toggle, reset priority for both inputs, reset assertion and deassertion away from clock edges.
verification.coverage: Directed sequences and deterministic mixed input/reset sequence.
verification.termination: Fatal on mismatch and bounded timeout; PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities.issue: Active clock edge is not explicitly named.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use rising edge, conventional synchronous FSM interpretation.

specification_ambiguities.issue: Pre-reset state and X/Z input behavior are unspecified.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: No power-up initialization; do not demand a specific pre-reset value or unspecified X/Z transitions.
